title: Repeated records with a missing request id or message id
policy: P4: when one id is missing, the other alone identifies the operation (a request id is unique per API request, a message id per response). Records with neither can't be deduplicated and are counted every time, but they are ambiguous and should be reported as such.
derivation: msg_04a without request id, output 50/80/120: one operation [100, 120]. req_04b without message id, output 10/20: one operation [5, 20]. One record with neither: [7, 3]. Expected [112, 143], 3 operations, 255 tokens. Today every repeat is counted in full: input 3x100 + 2x5 + 7 = 317, output 50+80+120 + 10+20 + 3 = 283, 6 calls, 600 tokens.
